organization.name: Banqup
organization.description:
Banqup is a European Qualified Trust Service Provider (QTSP) positioned to support the European Union Digital Identity / Business Wallet (EUDIW / EUBW) ecosystem, leveraging its active status on the Belgian Trusted List

Our EUBW-ready offerings include:
- QES for Remote Sealing/Signing: Fully compliant Qualified Electronic Signatures (QES) 
- QCert for QSeal: Qualified Certificates for Electronic Seals, enabling automated, cloud-based bulk sealing to legally secure outbound data, invoices, and attestations
- QeRDS: Qualified Electronic Registered Delivery Service to traceably and securely exchange credentials

Planned & Organizational Wallet Services:
Organizational Wallet Provider: Acting as a business wallet provider to enable legal entities to hold, manage, and present verified corporate credentials

Qualified Electronic Attestation of Attributes Provider (QEAAP) (Planned): Deploying QEAAP capabilities to issue legally recognized Qualified Electronic Attestations of Attributes (QEAA):
- IBAN Credentials: Support for the issuance of verified IBAN credentials 
- Verifier Attestations (Economic Operator): Enabling economic operators to hold and present identity data 

Banqup is an Active participant of the WeBuild Large Scale Pilot, driving the implementation standards for the European Business Wallet
